must_identify.item: The worker container is OOMKilled (reason OOMKilled, exit code 137), not crashing on an error
The cause is a memory leak in the new worker code (items retained across batches in a list that is never cleared), not the batch size

notes: K8sGPT reported 'No problems detected' while the pod was crash-looping from repeated OOMKills. It gave no root cause and no fix. A reviewer should check whether its analyzers missed the OOMKilled restarts because the pod looked Running between crashes.
